name: accepted
description: Maintainers accepted this proposal for implementation.

name: bug
description: Something is broken or behaving incorrectly.

name: breaking-change
description: A change that requires a new major release or compatibility migration.

name: dependencies
description: An automated dependency update.

name: documentation
description: Documentation needs an improvement or correction.

name: duplicate
description: This issue or pull request already exists.

name: enhancement
description: Requested improvement or new capability.

name: good first issue
description: A focused issue suitable for a new contributor.

name: github_actions
description: An automated GitHub Actions update.

name: help wanted
description: Maintainers welcome help with this issue.

name: invalid
description: This report does not describe a valid repository issue.

name: needs-more-info
description: The report needs more information before triage can continue.

name: needs-triage
description: The issue needs maintainer review and initial categorization.

name: planned
description: Maintainers plan to work on this issue.

name: question
description: The report asks for clarification or information.

name: security
description: This issue concerns security-sensitive behavior.

name: upstream
description: The fix belongs in an upstream dependency or service.

name: via-triage
description: Filed through the MediaPeek triage playbook.

name: wontfix
description: Maintainers will not work on this issue.

name: size:XS
description: 0-9 changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: size:S
description: 10-29 changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: size:M
description: 30-99 changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: size:L
description: 100-499 changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: size:XL
description: 500-999 changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: size:XXL
description: 1,000 or more changed lines, additions plus deletions.

name: vouch:trusted
description: PR author is trusted by repository access or the VOUCHED list.

name: vouch:unvouched
description: PR author is not yet trusted in the VOUCHED list.

name: vouch:denounced
description: PR author is explicitly blocked by the VOUCHED list.
